q: When was she born? (Make it active)
o: When was she being born?
By when was she born?
By when was she born from her mother?
When did her mother bear him?

q: 'It is time to shut up the shop.' The passive form is-
o: It is time for the shop to be shut up
It is time to be shut up the shop
It is time to shut the shop up
It is time the shop be shut up
e: It is time + to + verb গঠনের passive-এ It is time for + object + to be + V3 বসে, তাই It is time for the shop to be shut up। অর্থ: দোকান বন্ধ করার সময় হয়েছে। দ্বিতীয় অপশনে to be-এর পরে object বসানো ভুল। তৃতীয়টি active, আর চতুর্থটি ভিন্ন গঠনের subjunctive।

q: Identify the correct passive form: Do not spill the milk.
o: Let not the milk be spilled.
Let not the milk to be spilled.
The milk not be spelled.
Let not the milk spilled.

q: 'Who broke the pencil?' What is the passive form of this sentence?
o: By whom the pencil was broken?
By whom was the pencil broken?
The pencil was broken by whom?
Who was broken the pencil?
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু Past Indefinite প্রশ্নের passive-এ By whom + was + object + V3 বসে, তাই By whom was the pencil broken? অর্থ: পেন্সিলটি কে ভেঙেছিল? প্রশ্নে helping verb কর্তার আগে বসে, তাই প্রথম অপশন ভুল। তৃতীয়টিতে প্রশ্নশব্দ শেষে গেছে, আর চতুর্থটি ব্যাকরণগতভাবে অশুদ্ধ। break-এর রূপ: break, broke, broken।

q: Please buy me that book. (Passive)
o: You are being requested buy me that book.
I request you to give me that book.
You are requested to buy me that book.
You were requested to buy me that book.

q: The passive voice of 'One should take care of one's health.'
o: One's health should be taken care of
One's health should be taken care of by one
Health should be taken care of
Health should be taken care
e: One কর্তা হলে passive-এ তা বাদ যায়, আর one's যুক্ত শব্দ সাধারণ রূপে আসে: Health should be taken care of। অর্থ: স্বাস্থ্যের যত্ন নেওয়া উচিত। take care of একটি phrasal verb, তাই of শেষে থাকে; চতুর্থ অপশনে of বাদ পড়ে ভুল হয়েছে। দ্বিতীয় অপশনে অনর্থক by one আছে।

q: Some children were helping the wounded man.(make it passive)
o: The wounded man were being helped by some children.
The wounded man was being helped by some children.
The wounded man are being helped by some children.
The wounded man is being helped by some children.

q: The passive form of 'He pleases us'-
o: We were pleased with him.
We are pleased with him.
We are pleased by him.
We will be pleased by him.
e: Present indefinite তাই passive-এ ‘are + past participle’। ‘Please’ verb-এর passive-এ সাধারণত ‘by’-এর বদলে ‘with’ বসে: We are pleased with him.
s: কারিগরি শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, ক্যাশ সরকার ও অফিস সহায়ক (২০২১)

q: 'Open the door' (Make it passive)
o: Let the door be opened
Let the door opened
Let the door open
The door is opened
e: imperative sentence-এর passive হয় Let + object + be + past participle দিয়ে। তাই Open the door হয় Let the door be opened।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী শিক্ষক (৩য় ধাপ) (২০২৪)

q: They will complete the project by next week. (Make it passive)
o: The project will be completed by the following day by them.
The project will be completed by them by next week.
The project will have been completed by next week.
The project will be being completed by them by next week.

q: What is the correct active form of: "The thief was caught red-handed."?
o: People were catching the thief red-handed.
The thief had caught red-handed.
The police caught the thief red-handed.
Caught the thief red-handed.

q: Honey is sweet when it ___.
o: tested
tasted
is tasted
taste
e: mধু নিজে স্বাদ নেয় না, মানুষ তার স্বাদ নেয়, তাই এখানে passive: is tasted। এটি চিরন্তন সত্য, তাই present indefinite-এ লেখা হয়েছে। অর্থ: মধু খেলে সেটি মিষ্টি লাগে। tested মানে পরীক্ষা করা, তাই অর্থ ভিন্ন। tasted একা বসালে auxiliary থাকে না। taste active অর্থে ব্যবহার হলে it কর্তা হয়ে যায়, যা এখানে অযৌক্তিক।

q: Passive Voice of ‘Someone pulled the bull violently’?
o: The bull had been pulled violently by someone
The bull had been pulled violently
The bull was pulled violently
The bull was to be pulled violent by someone
e: Past indefinite বাক্যের passive-এ 'was + past participle' বসে। কর্তা 'someone' অনির্দিষ্ট বলে 'by someone' সাধারণত বাদ দেওয়া হয়।
s: বাংলাদেশ সিকিউরিটিজ অ্যান্ড এক্সচেঞ্জ কমিশন, ব্যক্তিগত কর্মকর্তা (২০২১)

q: Change the voice: I have a red cat.
o: A red cat is possessed by me
A red cat has been had by me
A red cat belongs to me by me
A red cat is to be had by me
e: have যখন অধিকার বোঝায়, তখন এর সাধারণ passive হয় না। বইয়ে আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে possess ক্রিয়ায় বদলে passive ধরা হয়: A red cat is possessed by me। অর্থ: একটি লাল বিড়াল আমার অধিকারে আছে। 'had by me' অস্বাভাবিক। belongs to নিজেই কর্তার সম্পর্ক বোঝায়, তাই by me যুক্ত করা ভুল। have, resemble জাতীয় ক্রিয়ার সাধারণত passive হয় না।

q: I shall be obliged to go. (Change the voice.)
o: Circumstances will oblige me to go
I will be my obligation to go
It will oblige me to go
Obligation will make me go
e: obliged to-এর মতো passive গঠনে কর্তা জানা না থাকলে যুক্তিসংগত একটি কর্তা ধরে active করতে হয়: Circumstances will oblige me to go। অর্থ: পরিস্থিতি আমাকে যেতে বাধ্য করবে। shall be obliged Future, তাই active-এ will oblige। দ্বিতীয় অপশন অর্থহীন, আর তৃতীয় ও চতুর্থ অপশনের কর্তা অসংগত।

q: I am to make a call. (Make it passive)
o: A call has to be made by me.
A call was to be made by me.
A call is to be made by me.
A call had to be made by me.

q: She determined to finish the task before sunset. (Change the voice)
o: She determined the task should be finished before sunset.
She determined that the task should be finished before sunset.
She determined that the task has to be finished before sunset.
The task was to be finished by her before sunset.

q: Mr. Zahid teaches us English. (Make it Passive)
o: By Mr. Zahid we are taught English.
We are being teaching English by Mr. Zahid.
We taught English by Mr. Zahid
English is taught to us by Mr. Zahid.

q: Change the voice: The basket contains freshly picked apples.
o: Freshly picked apples are contained with the basket.
Freshly picked apples are contained in the basket.
Freshly picked apples are contained by the basket.
Freshly picked apples are contained to the basket.

q: Choose the correct passive form: "He signs all the letters personally."
o: All the letters are signed by he personally.
All the letters are signed by him personally.
All the letters are being signed by him personally.
All the letters were signed by him personally.

q: He arranged to sell the house. (Make it passive)
o: He arranges that the house has to be sold.
He arranged that the house is being sold.
He arranged that the house to be sold.
He arranged that the house should be sold.

q: Find out the correct passive form of the following sentence: "Rice sells cheap."
o: Rice is being sold cheap.
Rice is cheap when it is sold.
Rice is cheap when it sells.
Rice sold cheap.

q: The news ___ by the BBC several times a day.
o: broadcast
broadcasting
is broadcast
been broadcasting
e: news নিজে সম্প্রচার করে না, বরং BBC সম্প্রচার করে, তাই এখানে passive voice লাগে। several times a day নিয়মিত কাজ বোঝায়, তাই present indefinite-এর passive: is broadcast। অর্থ: BBC দিনে কয়েকবার খবর প্রচার করে। broadcast-এর তিনটি রূপই একই (broadcast, broadcast, broadcast), তাই is broadcast লেখা যায়। broadcasting বা been broadcasting বসালে গঠন ঠিক থাকে না।

q: Don't waste your resources. (Make it passive)
o: Let your resources not to waste.
Let your resources not to be waste.
Let not your resources be wasted.
Let your resources to be not wasted.

q: Iron ___ for weapons and tools in the Bronze Age
o: is generally used
used
generally used
was generally used
e: Bronze Age অতীত যুগ, তাই Past Indefinite। লোহা ব্যবহৃত হতো, নিজে ব্যবহার করত না, তাই কর্মবাচ্য was generally used। অর্থ: ব্রোঞ্জ যুগে লোহা সাধারণত অস্ত্র ও যন্ত্রপাতির জন্য ব্যবহৃত হতো। Is generally used বর্তমান, used ও generally used-এ auxiliary নেই। Iron অগণনীয়, তাই was।

q: They could not solve the problem. (make it passive)
o: The problem could not be solved by them.
The problem should not be solved by them.
The problem could have solved by them.
The problem could not been solved by them.

q: Will she cook the dinner? Change the voice.
o: Will the dinner to be cooked by her?
Will the dinner being cooked by her?
Will the dinner cooked by her?
Will the dinner be cooked by her?

q: Change the voice: What did she purchase?
o: What was purchase by she?
What did purchased by her?
What was purchased by her?
What were purchased by her?
e: Active বাক্যটি Simple Past, এবং What দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্ন, তাই passive-এও What আগে বসে। Did বাদ যায়, তার জায়গায় was আসে, তারপর verb-এর past participle purchased, আর শেষে by + object form: What was purchased by her? Subject she হয় her। Were বহুবচনের জন্য, by she-তে ভুল case, আর passive-এ did ব্যবহার করা যায় না।

q: The bed feels soft. (make it passive)
o: The bed is felt when it is softer.
The bed feels softer.
The bed is soft when it feels.
The bed is soft when it is felt.

q: The company is going to announce the new policy. (Make it passive)
o: The new policy is going to be announced by the company.
The new policy was going to be announced by the company.
The new policy is gone to be announced by the company.
The new policy is being going to be announced by the company.

q: They must complete the project. (make it passive)
o: The project must be completed by they.
The project must been completed by them.
The project must have be completed by them.
The project must be completed by them.

q: What is the correct passive form of: "You must shut these doors"
o: These doors must be shut.
These doors must be shutted by you.
Shut the doors you must.
The doors must be shutted.

q: Indentify the correct passive form of "Open the window".
o: The window must be opened.
Let the window be opened by you.
The window should be opened.
Let the window be opened.

q: The passive voice of the sentence 'We made her recite a poem.'
o: A poem was made recite by her
She was made to recite a poem
She was made recited a poem
A poem was made to be recited
e: make-এর পরে bare infinitive থাকলে passive-এ to যুক্ত হয়, আর কর্ম her হয় She: She was made to recite a poem। অর্থ: আমরা তাকে একটি কবিতা আবৃত্তি করালাম। প্রথম অপশনে to নেই, তৃতীয়টিতে recited ভুল, আর চতুর্থটিতে কর্তা-কর্মের সম্পর্ক বদলে গেছে।

q: The teacher will be teaching us. বাক্যটির Passive form হবে-
o: We shall be taught by the teacher
We will be taught by the teacher
We shall be being taught by the teacher
We will be being taught by the teacher
e: Future continuous-এর passive গঠন হয় shall/will + be + being + past participle দিয়ে, আর প্রথম পুরুষ ‘We’-এর সাথে প্রথাগত ব্যাকরণে shall বসে। তাই ‘We shall be being taught by the teacher’; যদিও বাস্তবে এমন গঠন কম ব্যবহৃত হয়।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী শিক্ষক (সিলেট বিভাগ) (২০০৬)

q: Change the voice: Open the door.
o: The door has been opened.
Let the door opened.
The door must open.
Let the door be opened.
e: আদেশ বা অনুরোধসূচক imperative sentence-এর passive-এ Let দিয়ে শুরু হয়। Active-এর object (the door) subject হয়ে বসে, তারপর be এবং মূল verb-এর past participle আসে: Let the door be opened. Has been opened present perfect, তাতে আদেশের ভাব থাকে না; must open-এ verb active রূপে আছে; আর Let the door opened-এ be অনুপস্থিত থাকায় গঠন ভুল।

q: I decided to start a new hobby. [change the voice]
o: I decided a new hobby should be started.
I decided that a new hobby has to be started.
I decided that a new hobby should be started.
I decided that a new hobby to be started.

q: The passive voice of 'Who is John inviting'?
o: Who is being invited by John?
Who is invited by John?
Whom is invites by John?
Is someone invited by John?
e:
প্রশ্নের বাক্যটি present continuous tense-এ লেখা, তাই এর passive করতে am/is/are-এর পরে being এবং তারপর main verb-এর past participle বসাতে হয়। ‘Who’ দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রশ্নে কর্মের জায়গায় Who-ই থাকে, ফলে বাক্যটি দাঁড়ায় ‘Who is being invited by John?’। এখানে invite ক্রিয়ার past participle হলো invited। অন্য বিকল্পগুলোতে being বাদ পড়েছে, নয়তো ক্রিয়ার রূপ ভুল।
মনে রাখুন:
Present continuous passive-এর কাঠামো am/is/are + being + V3।
Past continuous passive-এর কাঠামো was/were + being + V3।

q: ‘Do not open the door’. বাক্যটির Passive form হবে-
o: Let not the door open
Let not the door be opened
Let not the door be open
Let not the door opened
e: না-বোধক imperative বাক্যের passive গঠন: Let not + object + be + past participle। তাই ‘Let not the door be opened’ সঠিক।

q: ‘We shall be blamed’ এর Active Voice কোনটি?
o: Everyone shall blame us
Everyone blame us
Everyone will blame us
Everyone is blaming us
e:
We shall be blamed বাক্যটি future indefinite tense-এর Passive Voice, এখানে কর্তার উল্লেখ নেই। এ রকম বাক্যকে Active করতে সাধারণ কর্তা হিসেবে someone বা everyone বসানো হয়। কর্তা third person হওয়ায় shall নয়, will বসবে, আর we কর্ম হয়ে us হবে। তাই Active রূপ হলো Everyone will blame us।
মনে রাখুন: Passive-এ কর্তা উহ্য থাকলে Active করার সময় someone, everyone, people বা they বসানো হয়।

q: In today's globalized world, indigenous culture ___ by foreign culture.
o: is assault
is assaulting
is to assault
is being assaulted
e: culture নিজে আক্রমণ করে না, বরং আক্রান্ত হয়, তাই passive দরকার। 'today' চলমান অবস্থা বোঝায়, তাই present continuous passive: is being assaulted। অর্থ: বর্তমান বিশ্বায়নের যুগে দেশীয় সংস্কৃতি বিদেশি সংস্কৃতির দ্বারা আক্রান্ত হচ্ছে। is assault গঠন হিসেবে ভুল। is assaulting active অর্থ দেয়, যা by-এর সাথে মেলে না।

q: "Who planted this tree here"? The correct passive voice of this sentence is-
o: By whom the tree was planted here?
Who the tree had been planted hereby?
The tree was planted here by whom?
By whom had the tree been planted here?

q: Identify the correct passive form of the sentence : "Who will do the work?"
o: Whom the work will be done?
By whom will the work be done?
Who the work will be done by?
By who the work will be done?
e:
Active voice-এর Who will do the work? বাক্যটিকে passive করলে ‘Who’ বদলে ‘By whom’ হয়, কারণ passive-এ কর্তা by-এর পরে বসে এবং object-form ‘whom’ লাগে। Active-এর will do হয়ে passive-এ will be done। তাই শুদ্ধ রূপ: By whom will the work be done?
মনে রাখুন: Will/shall থাকলে passive-এ will be/shall be + past participle বসে।
s: বাংলাদেশ রেলওয়ে, উপসহকারী প্রকৌশলী ও অন্যান্য পদ (২০২৪)

q: 'All his pupils like him' বাক্যের সঠিক passive form-
o: He was liked by all his pupils
He is like by all his pupils
He is being liked by all his pupils
He is liked by all his pupils
e: Present indefinite-এর passive: object + is + past participle + by + subject। তাই: He is liked by all his pupils।

q: Identify the correct passive from of 'Who did this'?
o: By whom was this done?
By whom has this done?
By whom this has been done?
By whom this had been done?
e:
Active voice বাক্য ‘Who did this?’-এ who কর্তা এবং verb হলো Past Indefinite (did)। Who দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নবাচক বাক্যকে passive করতে হলে ‘By whom’ দিয়ে শুরু করে auxiliary verb আগে বসাতে হয়। Past Indefinite-এর passive-এ was বা were লাগে এবং মূল verb-এর past participle (done) হয়। তাই উত্তর: By whom was this done? বাকি বিকল্পগুলোতে auxiliary verb ভুল জায়গায় আছে অথবা tense মেলেনি।
মনে রাখুন:
Who wrote the letter? → By whom was the letter written?
Who is doing the work? → By whom is the work being done?

q: The skilled poacher shot the bear. (Make it passive)
o: The bear was shoot by the skilled poacher.
The bear was shot by the skilled poacher.
The bear is shoted by the skilled poacher.
The bear is shoot by the skilled poacher.

q: Change the voice : I shall not help you.
o: You shall not be helped by me.
I shall not be helped by you.
I will not be helped by you.

q: The passive form of 'We called him a fool' is—
o: He had been called a fool by us.
He was called a fool by us.
He is called a fool by us.
He has been called a fool by us.
e:
‘We called him a fool’ বাক্যে him হলো object, আর a fool তার সম্পূরক। Past Indefinite Tense-এর passive-এ object subject হয়ে বসে, তারপর was/were এবং verb-এর past participle আসে। তাই ‘He was called a fool by us’। সম্পূরক a fool আগের মতোই থাকে। বাকি অপশনগুলোতে Past Perfect বা Present Perfect বসেছে, যা মূল বাক্যের কালের সঙ্গে মেলে না।
মনে রাখুন: Past Indefinite-এর passive গঠন: Subject + was/were + past participle + by + object।
উদাহরণ: They elected him captain. = He was elected captain.
s: জাতীয় জনসংখ্যা গবেষণা ও প্রশিক্ষণ ইনস্টিটিউট (নিপোর্ট), হোম ইকোনমিস্ট (২০২৪)

q: 'I had written the letter.'
o: The letter was written by me
The letter had been written by me
The letter was being written by me
The letter was wrote by me
e: Past Perfect active-এর passive কাঠামো had been + V3, তাই The letter had been written by me। অর্থ: আমি চিঠিটি লিখে ফেলেছিলাম। was written Past Indefinite, was being written Past Continuous, আর was wrote ব্যাকরণগতভাবে ভুল। Perfect tense passive-এ been থাকবেই।

q: 'I shall do the work.'
o: I shall be doing the work
The work may be done by me
The work will be done by me
The work would be done by me
e: Future Indefinite active-এর passive কাঠামো shall/will be + V3। আদি বাক্য 'I shall do', তাই passive-এ The work will be done by me। অর্থ: কাজটি আমার দ্বারা করা হবে। প্রথম অপশন active, আর may ও would ভিন্ন modal, তাই কাল বদলে যায়। passive-এ কর্ম এখানে কর্তার জায়গা নেয়।
